records.jp: “向こうの世界”が出てきたときも<CR>二人でこうして話してたんだっけ
records.en_original: We were talking like this when the Faraway first appeared, weren't we?
records.en: We were talking like this when the Faraway first appeared, weren't we?

records.jp: うん、そうだったね――
records.en_original: Yeah, that's right—
records.en: Yeah, that's right—

records.jp: この場所、わたしのお気に入りなのです。<CR>なんだか、秘密基地みたいだから
records.en_original: I like this place. There's just something about it that makes me feel safe and secure.
records.en: I like this place. There's just something about it that makes me feel safe and secure.

records.jp: こころは、秘密基地が好きなの？
records.en_original: How so?
records.en: How so?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: It's like my own secret hideout.
records.en: It's like my own secret hideout.

records.jp: なんで好きなの？
records.en_original: Did you ever build secret hideouts as a kid?
records.en: Did you ever build secret hideouts as a kid?

records.jp: なんで？　ええと……あれ、なんでかな……
records.en_original: Did I...?
records.en: Did I...?

records.jp: 秘密基地……秘密基地……。
records.en_original: Secret hideout... Secret hideout...
records.en: Secret hideout... Secret hideout...

records.jp: なんだか、懐かしい気がするから――
records.en_original: Something tells me maybe I—
records.en: Something tells me maybe I—

records.jp: な、何！？
records.en_original: Wh-what's going on?!
records.en: Wh-what's going on?!

records.jp: あれ見て！　あそこに……
records.en_original: Look! Over there...
records.en: Look! Over there...

records.jp: ……なんか出てきた
records.en_original: That thing came out of nowhere.
records.en: That thing came out of nowhere.

records.jp: これも、この世界じゃ普通なの？
records.en_original: Is this normal here?
records.en: Is this normal here?

records.jp: ううん。<CR>こんなの初めて
records.en_original: No... I've never seen anything like it.
records.en: No... I've never seen anything like it.

records.jp: なんなの、いったい……
records.en_original: What is it...?
records.en: What is it...?

records.jp: 急にあんなのが現れて、びっくりしたよ
records.en_original: That sure was a surprise, huh?
records.en: That sure was a surprise, huh?

records.jp: 結局何が原因ででてきたんだろう？
records.en_original: I wonder what made it appear...
records.en: I wonder what made it appear...

records.jp: あ、ねえ。<CR>もしかしたらリフナビが何か知ってるかも
records.en_original: Oh, maybe ReSource would know something.
records.en: Oh, maybe ReSource would know something.

records.jp: リフナビが？
records.en_original: You think?
records.en: You think?

records.jp: うん。ちょっと聞いてみようよ
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's ask.
records.en: Yeah. Let's ask.

records.jp: リフナビさん
records.en_original: ReSource?
records.en: ReSource?

records.jp: はよ～ん☆<CR>どうしたの？
records.en_original: Hello hello hello! How can I help you?
records.en: Hello hello hello! How can I help you?

records.jp: 線路の先の世界ってどうしてでてきたの？
records.en_original: Why did that world appear all of a sudden?
records.en: Why did that world appear all of a sudden?

records.jp: それはここでの暮らしには関係ないから、<CR>答えられないよ！
records.en_original: That has nothing to do with living here, so I'm afraid I can't answer that!
records.en: That has nothing to do with living here, so I'm afraid I can't answer that!

records.jp: けち！！
records.en_original: How rude!
records.en: How rude!

records.jp: いけず！！！
records.en_original: Yeah, you're mean!
records.en: Yeah, you're mean!

records.jp: あ、勇希だ
records.en_original: Oh, hey Yuki
records.en: Oh, hey Yuki

records.jp: やっほ～<CR>そろそろ夕飯ができるよ！　作業室まで集合っ！
records.en_original: Hiya! Dinner's almost ready, get over here!
records.en: Hiya! Dinner's almost ready, get over here!

records.jp: りょうかいっ！
records.en_original: Yes, ma'am!
records.en: Yes, ma'am!

records.jp: やっぱりわからないかあ……
records.en_original: Guess it was a stretch...
records.en: Guess it was a stretch...

records.jp: （“向こうの世界”が現れた日。<CR>私たちに、もう一つの変化が訪れた）
records.en_original: (Something else happened on that day the Faraway appeared.)
records.en: (Something else happened on that day the Faraway appeared.)

records.jp: （それがコイツ、リフナビの登場だ）
records.en_original: (This ReSource thing showed up too.)
records.en: (This ReSource thing showed up too.)

records.jp: リフナビさんがグループに参加しました
records.en_original: ReSource joined the group.
records.en: ReSource joined the group.

records.jp: ちょっとちょっと！<CR>いったい何したの！？
records.en_original: Hey! What have you done?!
records.en: Hey! What have you done?!

records.en_original: Who is this...?
records.en: Who is this...?

records.jp: し、知らない……
records.en_original: I have no idea...
records.en: I have no idea...

records.jp: リフナビさん
records.en_original: ReSource...
records.en: ReSource...

records.jp: あなたは誰？
records.en_original: Who are you?
records.en: Who are you?

records.jp: 私はリフナビっ！　ここでの暮らしをサポートする<CR>スーパーお役立ち情報提供アカウントだよ☆
records.en_original: I'm ReSource! Your super-duper guide to help you with everything you need to live here!
records.en: I'm ReSource! Your super-duper guide to help you with everything you need to live here!

records.jp: ここって、この世界のこと？<CR>何か知ってるの！？
records.en_original: By "here," do you mean this world? Do you know something about this place?!
records.en: By "here," do you mean this world? Do you know something about this place?!

records.jp: それはここでの暮らしに関係ないから、<CR>答えられないよ！
records.en_original: As that has nothing to do with living here, I'm afraid I can't answer that!
records.en: As that has nothing to do with living here, I'm afraid I can't answer that!

records.jp: ええ……。<CR>なんでも教えてくれるわけじゃないのか
records.en_original: Aww... I thought you would tell us whatever we wanted...
records.en: Aww... I thought you would tell us whatever we wanted...

records.jp: まあまあ。<CR>答えられそうなところから聞いてみようよ
records.en_original: Well, I guess we can start by asking about things it should be able to tell us
records.en: Well, I guess we can start by asking about things it should be able to tell us

records.jp: ねえ。急に現れたアレって何なのかな？
records.en_original: So, what's that thing that suddenly appeared?
records.en: So, what's that thing that suddenly appeared?

records.jp: あそこはとても危険なんだ！<CR>絶対に近づかないようにしてね☆
records.en_original: That place is super dangerous! You should NOT, under ANY CIRCUMSTANCES, go near it!
records.en: That place is super dangerous! You should NOT, under ANY CIRCUMSTANCES, go near it!

records.jp: 危険？　どうして？
records.en_original: Dangerous? Why?
records.en: Dangerous? Why?

records.jp: それは、あそこがここではない世界に<CR>繋がっているからだよ♪
records.en_original: Because it's connected to a different world from this one!
records.en: Because it's connected to a different world from this one!

records.jp: ここではない世界？？？？？
records.en_original: A different world from this one?????
records.en: A different world from this one?????

records.jp: とにかく絶対に近づいちゃダメ！<CR>何が起きても知らないよ☆
records.en_original: Yes, so do not go near it! There's no telling what might happen if you do.
records.en: Yes, so do not go near it! There's no telling what might happen if you do.

records.jp: 危ない場所……か
records.en_original: Dangerous, huh...
records.en: Dangerous, huh...

records.jp: ……行ってみようよ。<CR>“向こうの世界”に
records.en_original: We should go. To the other world.
records.en: We should go. To the other world.

records.jp: えっ！？　でもリフナビが危ないって……
records.en_original: What?! But ReSource said it was dangerous...
records.en: What?! But ReSource said it was dangerous...

records.jp: でも、あそこに手がかりがあるかもしれないのです。<CR>愛央ちゃんが元の世界に戻るための
records.en_original: But we might be able to get some clues there—about how you can get back to your world.
records.en: But we might be able to get some clues there—about how you can get back to your world.

records.jp: （これが、リフナビとの出会いだった）
records.en_original: (That's how we met ReSource.)
records.en: (That's how we met ReSource.)

records.jp: （その後、こころが皆を説得して……<CR>“向こうの世界”を探索することになったんだ）
records.en_original: (After that, Kokoro convinced everyone to explore the Faraway.)
records.en: (After that, Kokoro convinced everyone to explore the Faraway.)
